name: surdet
description: Surdet Engine - a mature, data-driven desktop galgame engine

scripts.build: npm run build -w @surdet/core && npm run build -w @surdet/authoring && npm run build -w @surdet/cli && npm run build -w @surdet/renderer && npm run build -w @surdet/host && npm run build -w @surdet/shell && npm run build -w surdet-editor && npm run build -w surdet-starter
scripts.test: npm run build -w @surdet/core && npm run build -w @surdet/authoring && npm run build -w @surdet/cli && npm run build -w @surdet/renderer && npm run build -w @surdet/host && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @surdet/core && npm run build -w @surdet/authoring && npm run build -w @surdet/renderer && npm run build -w @surdet/host && npm run typecheck -w @surdet/authoring && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify:p1p2: npm run verify:p1p2:policy && npm run verify:all
scripts.verify:formal: npm run lint -w zero-after-midnight && npm run simulate -w zero-after-midnight && node examples/zero-after-midnight/scripts/check-assets.mjs
